test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of Interest (R) = 3% per year

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (3000 × 3 × 6) / 100

⇒ SI = 54000 / 100

⇒ SI = 540

**The simple interest is ₹540.**
